# Lead Developer

We need a hands-on lead developer to own architecture and delivery of cloud-hosted web platforms.

## Required

- Strong C# and ASP.NET Core experience
- Technical leadership, mentoring and code review
- API and distributed-system design
- Automated testing, CI/CD and release ownership
- Azure, containers and production performance engineering

## Preferred

- Kubernetes
- PostgreSQL or SQL Server
- Practical use of AI-assisted development
